bpBridge.name: BP Pedestrian Bridge (serpentine)

abutmentWest.note: behind the Pritzker Pavilion stage (east side of the Great Lawn / Harris Theater)

abutmentEast.note: lands on the Maggie Daley Park mound

bpBridge.notes: Brushed stainless-steel plate side panels that curve in plan like a snake; hardwood deck; box-girder spine on concrete piers. Gradient kept near 5% (wheelchair access), so it snakes to gain length. Deck heights are estimates: ~5 m clearance over Columbus Dr (deck top ~6 m).

maggieDaley.note: The park is the green roof of the Millennium Lakeside Garage (layer 1); ground ~1-3 m above Columbus/Randolph at the edges, mounded lawns rise ~3-5 m more.

skatingRibbon.augustUse: walking / roller path (ice ribbon in winter); low granite/concrete curb walls both sides ~0.6-1 m, the inner hill rises in the middle

fieldhouse.name: Maggie Daley Park Fieldhouse
fieldhouse.note: low glass-and-wood pavilion with green roof by Randolph St; rental, restrooms, cafe

climbingWall.name: Climbing wall sculpture
climbingWall.basis: Google Maps satellite 2026-11-07 (label "Maggie Daley Park Climbing Wall"; dark faceted structure inside the skating-ribbon loop) + public descriptions (about 40 ft tall)
climbingWall.note: Faceted, ice-shard-like grey sculpture with climbing holds on its faces, rising out of the hill that the skating ribbon wraps around. The ribbon passes under and beside it.

lurieGarden.name: Lurie Garden
lurieGarden.note: perennial "light plate" + "dark plate" divided by the Seam boardwalk (water channel); 4.5 m hedge "shoulder" on the north and west sides

nicholsBridgeway.note: Renzo Piano blade-like steel bridge from the Art Institute Modern Wing 3rd-floor terrace (south) down over Monroe St to the Great Lawn SW corner; deck ~18 m above Monroe at the museum end (estimate), descending north

wrigleySquarePeristyle.name: Wrigley Square peristyle (Millennium Monument)
wrigleySquarePeristyle.note: semicircular row of ~40 ft (12 m) Doric columns, a replica of the 1917 peristyle, at Michigan & Randolph; fountain + lawn (Wrigley Square) in front, to the south

harrisTheater.name: Harris Theater (mostly underground; low entrance box)

pritzkerTrellis.note: Crisscrossing DIAGONAL curved steel pipes (seen on satellite as two families of arcs at roughly +-45 deg) over the fixed seating and Great Lawn, carrying the speaker array; bays about 20 m (estimate). gridX/gridZ give an axis-aligned approximation; for fidelity, rotate the lattice 45 deg about the lawn centre.

boeingGalleries.note: Two long, narrow sunken/terrace galleries along the Chase Promenade edge: Boeing Gallery North (north of Cloud Gate, beside the Harris/Pritzker) and Boeing Gallery South (between Crown Fountain and Monroe). Open-air outdoor sculpture terraces, not buildings: flat plazas with temporary artworks. Polygons not in OSM; positions estimated.

moorings.note: Mooring balls (cans) from OSM seamark nodes. Operator (Chicago Park District) quotes 392 mooring cans for Monroe; OSM maps fewer/more depending on survey. Boats swing on a single mooring: give each a random heading within +-25 deg of the wind (summer SW wind -> bows to SW).

dusable.name: DuSable Harbor
dusable.note: 420 slips (operator); boats 30-60 ft+ berthed bow-in between finger piers off docks A-H; main docks run E-W.

chicagoYachtClubMonroe.name: Chicago Yacht Club, Monroe Station
chicagoYachtClubMonroe.note: low clubhouse on the harbour wall at the foot of Monroe St; private docks alongside

columbiaYachtClub.note: clubhouse is a retired ship (former ferry, ~110 m) moored at the north end of Monroe Harbor by Randolph St

monroeTender.note: tender (launch) service landing at Monroe St

uscgStation.note: US Coast Guard DuSable Harbor station

monroe.note: Mooring field = mostly sailboats (sloops 27-42 ft, white hulls, masts 10-18 m); some trawlers / express cruisers. Peak season, nearly full.

dusable.note: Slip harbour = mostly power boats (express cruisers, motor yachts, a few sportfishers), plus some larger sailboats.

boatMixAugust.underway: August weekends: 20-60 boats moving between the harbours, the lock and the Playpen anchorage off Ohio St Beach; tour boats and water taxis from Navy Pier.
boatMixAugust.basis: estimates from public harbour descriptions (operator counts: Monroe 392 mooring cans, DuSable 420 slips, 30-60 ft+) and satellite views
